title: Affiliate Management 2.0 Part 2: why the hard pitch to publishers is dead
summary: Dustin Howes's LinkedIn post and webinar recap on publisher outreach in 2026. His own framing: hard pitches get smelled instantly by overloaded publishers, AI visibility data should be layered, and publishers losing Google traffic are opening doors to whitelisting deals. Most substance in the transcript comes from guests.

principles.text: Hard-pitch outreach no longer works on publishers buried in email.
principles.quote: The hard pitch is dead. Publishers getting a hundred emails a day can smell it immediately.

principles.text: Layer several AI visibility data sets rather than betting on one tool.
principles.quote: Why layering your AI visibility data matters more than picking the right tool

principles.text: Publishers losing Google traffic are more open to whitelisting deals, which should shape outreach strategy.
principles.quote: how publishers losing Google traffic are quietly opening doors to whitelisting deals and what that means for your outreach strategy.

principles.text: Create content with the purpose of ranking in LLMs, even while attribution and clicks lag behind.
principles.quote: I'm trying to get ahead and rank for LM's, like my contents actually going out with purpose to try to rank for LM for the future.
